review_kind: Independent limited static and bounded real-source native review of 324 only
scope: Finite Copy Array/Tuple/Record values of at least 4096 physical bytes lowered to private per-ValueId entry-stack snapshots; original 262144-byte a18 source and bounded neighboring Copy/alias/layout/index controls.

identity.shared_emit_delta: Compared with component5825, common022 emit.rs adds only 10 structured-thread integration lines. The 324 planner, snapshot/event paths and tests are unchanged. Thread/325 behavior is excluded from this review.
identity.authority: Read current main-tree AGENTS.md, _zil_goal.md, task324 and its frozen scope. Parent full-suite results were not counted as reviewer evidence.

static_checks.verification_boundary: bind_lir exactly rebinds target, resources, functions, closures and layouts to the supplied immutable VerifiedModule before building copy plans. This backend rewrite grants no new source Copy/borrow/ownership authority.
static_checks.snapshot_and_alias: Plan is keyed by actual FunctionId and ValueId. Each eligible value has a distinct entry alloca; Load/ReadAddress copy at the original definition point. UpdateField/UpdateIndex copy to the output snapshot before mutation; Store/WriteAddress copy out. Source Address creation continues to name ordinary local/parameter storage, never private copy.value pointers. Verified SSA identities keep input/output snapshots distinct for memcpy.
static_checks.layout: Layout is derived from llvm_type, with checked recursive layout and i64 range bounds, on supported little-endian x64 targets. Aggregate Unit is an empty struct, Bool i1 occupies one allocated byte, arrays use full element allocation stride, structs include alignment/tail padding. Constructor memset initializes the destination including padding. Envelope(Unit,Bool,4096-byte array,i64) has the tested seven-byte gap before tail.
static_checks.dynamic_index: widened_index is compared unsigned against array length before GEP. Negative signed indices widen to values that fail the unsigned check; failure branches to the existing defined zil.trap path. Update copies only after bounds success.
static_checks.control_and_order: Current LIR joins go through actual local Store/Load. Static value slots are rewritten at each dynamic definition, with no newly introduced pointer phi. Copy argument preparation before side-effecting RHS is preserved by snapshotting at the LIR position.
static_checks.helper_and_optimization: Private internal zil.copy.bytes/zil.zero.bytes helpers contain real LLVM memcpy/memset with dynamic byte count and nonvolatile flag. Their only added function attribute is NoInline; no optnone or forced O0 was found. Model/name lowering and both emit routes consume this function attribute; machine preflight rejects it in result/parameter positions and rejects duplicate attributes.
static_checks.abi_bridge: copy_argument explicitly materializes an old SSA aggregate when a legacy consumer requires it; signatures and call ABI remain unchanged. This is an admitted limitation, not a silent pointer ABI, changed backend or reduced input.
static_checks.cache_key: Static review of object_cache::machine_key confirms namespace, target triple and complete ordered module.items are hashed, including helper bodies and NoInline attributes. Namespace additionally binds installed compiler/library identity, target/rules and requested optimization/pipeline. Diagnostic fingerprint is intentionally not object authority. No independent cache-hit replay was run here.
static_checks.prepayment: One module-level remaining work pool plans recursive Copy eligibility/layout and bounded metadata before growth; retained plans are read-only during function lowering. Emission reserves a shape/operand upper bound and helper cost. Small aggregate preflight adds Codegen work, so no universal unchanged-old-cost claim is accepted.

independent_validation.command: source /workspace/.zil-env/env.sh; CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/workspace/.zil-env/target325 CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=1 cargo test -p zil-driver --features llvm-api --test aggregates large_ -- --nocapture --test-threads=1

a18.limits: Per profile CPU45s, VM2GiB, wall55s, native5s, core0. Original source was not reduced or replaced.

semantic_controls.actual_profiles: Existing native_entry helper uses default Clang O0 and explicit Clang -O2 rebuild of emitted LLVM. Enabling llvm-api does not change that helper default; these semantic cases are not claimed as an API four-profile matrix.
semantic_controls.out_of_bounds: Both existing Clang runs fail as required; the test checks unsuccessful exit, not an exact signal. The explicit guard-to-trap path was additionally inspected statically.
semantic_controls.near_threshold_by_value: 4096-byte inspect(value,marker) is exercised by the order/alias case; this does not establish general huge by-value ABI support.

limitations: General large by-value parameter/result ABI, closure and enum/error legacy-materialization consumers remain unvalidated/unfixed by this slice. large-array-a18-by-value.zil was not executed here and is not marked as a newly reproduced failure or success.
The exact budget boundary covers the original a18 path, not a proof of unchanged cost for all old inputs or every legacy ABI bridge.
Per-value snapshots and noinline calls have real stack/runtime costs; no same-semantics Rust performance/RSS or maintenance comparison was performed.
No formal full suite, Windows native validation, independent object-cache runtime replay or new broad stress matrix was run by this reviewer.
Historical crash and O2 resource-limit observations in recovery-large-array.json remain historical; this review adds bounded current-source success and does not rewrite those failures.
This review excludes 325 concurrency/SABI/Mutex and does not independently certify code authored by the reviewer. Full language/ZUI/B0/product status is not upgraded.
